proof_body:
by
  rintro a b K ⟨s, hs⟩ hmono hK
  obtain ⟨C, hC'⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto _ hs).exists_norm_le
  have hC : ∀ n, ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i‖ ≤ C := fun n => hC' _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  rcases hmono with hm | hm
  · have hbB := tendsto_atTop_ciSup hm ⟨K, by
      rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hK n)⟩
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => b n - ⨆ i, b i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hbB.sub_const (⨆ i, b i)
    have hmm : Monotone (fun n => b n - ⨆ i, b i) := fun m n h => sub_le_sub_right (hm h) _
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (hmm.cauchySeq_series_mul_of_tendsto_zero_of_bounded h0 hC)
    refine ⟨t + (⨆ i, b i) * s, (ht.add (hs.const_mul (⨆ i, b i))).congr fun n => ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · have hbB := tendsto_atTop_ciInf hm ⟨-K, by
      rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (abs_le.1 (hK n)).1⟩
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => b n - ⨅ i, b i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hbB.sub_const (⨅ i, b i)
    have hmm : Antitone (fun n => b n - ⨅ i, b i) := fun m n h => sub_le_sub_right (hm h) _
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (hmm.cauchySeq_series_mul_of_tendsto_zero_of_bounded h0 hC)
    refine ⟨t + (⨅ i, b i) * s, (ht.add (hs.const_mul (⨅ i, b i))).congr fun n => ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℝ), (∃ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a i) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) → (Monotone b ∨ Antitone b) → (∀ n, |b n| ≤ K) → ∃ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a i * b i) Filter.atTop (nhds t)
